articles.title: Afectados por la Dana Adam, el Consejo de Ministros aprueba por decreto ley la incapacidad temporal por catástrofe
articles.summary:
El pasado martes, la ministra Elma Saiz anunció que las secuelas laborales de catástrofes como la dana Adam tendrán más protección. La norma es el Real Decreto-ley 31/2026, publicado hoy en el BOE y en vigor desde ayer, miércoles 21 de octubre. Conviene leer la letra pequeña: el texto no crea una prestación nueva para los afectados de Valencia, sino que deja abierta la puerta para hacerlo.
Qué dice el BOE. La nueva disposición adicional 64.ª de la Ley General de la Seguridad Social permite que las normas con rango de ley aprobadas tras una catástrofe asimilen a contingencia profesional prestaciones como la incapacidad temporal, la permanente o las de fallecimiento y supervivencia. En la práctica, la baja se trataría como la de un accidente de trabajo: 75% de la base reguladora desde el día siguiente y sin cotización previa. El preámbulo defiende dejarlo con carácter permanente para dar una respuesta homogénea, inmediata y previsible.
Lo que el BOE no hace es declarar la dana Adam como esa catástrofe ni fijar cuantías. Eso exige una norma específica, como la de 2024, que llegó junto con la declaración de zona gravemente afectada. El Gobierno sostiene que la medida podrá activarse sin recurrir a medidas extraordinarias; los primeros análisis jurídicos la leen como una habilitación. El decreto, además, debe convalidarse en el Congreso. articles.title: One UI 9.0 aterriza en los Galaxy A más vendidos: estos son los Samsung compatibles con Android 17

articles.title: Google Chrome s'appuie sur Gemini pour détecter les arnaques en ligne
articles.summary:
L’explosion des arnaques en ligne alimentées par l’IA pousse Google à renforcer la sécurité de Chrome. Le navigateur Web s’est en effet enrichi de nouvelles mesures de sécurité intégrées dans son mode Protection renforcée. Grâce à Gemini, Chrome peut identifier les tentatives d’arnaque les plus subtiles en s’appuyant notamment sur une analyse textuelle du contenu des pages en temps réel.
Introduit en 2020, le mode protection renforcé de Chrome comptait, en 2025, plus d’un milliard d’utilisateurs à travers le monde d’après Google. articles.title: Voitures électriques : cette étude de 2026 révèle les marques qui déçoivent le plus les propriétaires
articles.summary:
Voitures électriques : cette étude de 2026 révèle les marques qui déçoivent le plus les propriétaires
Alors que la satisfaction des conducteurs de voitures électriques bat des records en 2026, une vaste étude épingle certains constructeurs, notamment sur la recharge, la navigation embarquée ou encore l’application mobile dédiée au véhicule.
Tandis qu’on apprenait que 96 % des Français étaient satisfaits de leur passage à la voiture électrique, la tendance se confirme en Allemagne, en Suisse et en Autriche, d’après une récente étude du cabinet USCALE menée auprès de 4 004 conducteurs. Être convaincu ne signifie cependant pas que tout est rose dans cette transition, avec des faiblesses marquées chez certaines marques pour offrir une expérience utilisateur sans accroc.
Un grand écart de satisfaction et de recommandation selon les constructeurs
Pour commencer, le dernier “Net Promoter Score (NPS)”, indice évaluant à quel point les propriétaires sont prêts à vanter les mérites de leur véhicule auprès de leur entourage, atteint les 38 points en 2026, soit 5 points de plus par rapport à 2025. Le constructeur chinois Xpeng conserve en effet sa première place avec 82 % de clients promoteurs, salué pour ses performances de charge, son autonomie et les nets progrès de son application. Tesla remonte de la sixième à la de…

articles.title: Capcom confirms data breach affecting 11.7 million accounts
articles.summary:
Japanese gaming giant Capcom has confirmed that hackers breached its membership service, CAPCOM ID, exposing more than 11.7 million customer email addresses and associated information.
Apart from emails, exposed data includes account creation date, last login timestamp, number of logins, and the IP address used at the last login.
Capcom found that for a small subset of 43 accounts, dates of birth, gender, nicknames, and countries were also exposed.
For another subset of 196 accounts, the hackers changed the CAPCOM ID login passwords in an attempt to lock the owners out, but the company took action and reset them.
In an alert today, the gaming company says that passwords for all other registered members have not been exposed and that credit card information remained unaffected.
Capcom is a Japanese video game developer and publisher known for franchises such as Resident Evil, Monster Hunter, Street Fighter, and Mega Man. The company has 4,000 employees and an annual revenue of $1.24 billion.
CAPCOM ID is the company’s shared account system used for accessing its web services and playing some of its online games.
Although the timing of the breach remains unclear, Capcom said it detected suspicious activity and confirmed unauthorized access on October 19.
An investigation was launched immediately, and by the following day, it was clear that customer information had been compromised.
October 21, the company reported the incident to the police and to Japan’s Personal Information P…

articles.title: Des rafales à plus de 100 km/h : la tempête Austen s'apprête à balayer le nord-ouest de la France
articles.summary:
La France se prépare à l’arrivée de la tempête Austen. Météo-France a prévenu ce mercredi 21 octobre que la « première tempête de l’automne » arrivait sur l’hexagone. Le service de météorologie annonce un « risque de rafales dépassant 100 km/h sur la Bretagne, la Normandie et les Hauts-de-France dès la nuit de jeudi et dans la journée de vendredi ».
Ce jeudi 22 octobre, 3 départements sont placés en vigilance orange vent, en raison de l’arrivée de cette tempête. Vendredi, la vigilance orange concernera 15 départements.
La tempête a été nommée Austen par le Met Office, le service national britannique de météorologie, le 20 octobre. « Une zone de basse pression se formant dans l’Atlantique va rapidement s’intensifier sous l’effet du courant-jet », a prévenu le Met Office.
Pourquoi un nom choisi par les Britanniques ? Météo-France baptise elle aussi des tempêtes, avec ses homologues d’Espagne, du Portugal, de Belgique, du Luxembourg et d’Andorre, pour les dépressions susceptibles de toucher l’un de ces pays. Austen vient de la liste du Met Office, qui l’a nommée le premier : le Royaume-Uni est lui aussi sur sa trajectoire, et une alerte jaune au vent y a été émise pour le sud de l’Angleterre et le sud du pays de Galles.

Sur les réseaux sociaux, des spécialistes et passionnés de météorologie partagent des cartes issues des modèles de prévision, qui montrent la trajectoire attendue de la tempête vers les côtes françaises et le Royau…

articles.title: SA’s Happy Pay launches pay-per-sale ad platform after $6.1m pilot - Disrupt Africa
articles.summary:
South African buy now, pay later (BNPL) platform Happy Pay has publicly launched Happy Ads, an AI-powered performance media platform that only charges retailers when a campaign results in a sale.
Happy Pay provides zero-cost installment payments through its ad-subsidised payments network. Its platform connects merchants with high-intent shoppers, enabling consumers to split purchases into interest-free installments while helping retailers grow through performance-based customer acquisition, conversion, and basket expansion. The company raised a US$5 million seed round back in March.
Happy Ads lets brands promote products and offers to Happy Pay’s more than 800,000 registered users, as well as two million customers across its partner network. It generated more than ZAR100 million (US$6.1 million) in merchant sales during its pilot phase, delivering more than 268 million impressions and an average 20x return on ad spend. Happy Pay says a further six million users are set to join the network soon.
Unlike traditional digital advertising, where brands pay for impressions or clicks, Happy Ads works on a cost-per-acquisition model. Retailers set the commission they are willing to pay and are only charged when a campaign converts into a completed sale.
“Most digital advertising platforms sell attention and leave retailers hoping that attention eventually turns into revenue,” said Wesley Billett, co-founder and CEO of Happy Pay. “Happy Ads flips that model. If we don’t generate a sale…

articles.title: Vercel Labs Open-Sources fx: A Zig Coding Agent Designed to Be Embedded
articles.summary:
Vercel Labs has released fx as open source, an experimental coding agent and command-line tool written in Zig and built to be scripted or embedded rather than run as a full-screen terminal application.
Announced in August 2026, fx ships as a 6.3 MiB native binary with a reported single-digit-megabyte memory baseline and a 10-microsecond cold start, figures Vercel states rather than independently verified benchmarks. Instead of taking over the terminal with a persistent interface, fx writes its conversation into ordinary scrollback and exposes the same engine through both a CLI and a library.
The result is aimed at developers building agent infrastructure more than at people looking for another chat window. Structured output is available for automation, so a script or CI job can call a command and parse the response:
fx ask --json "summarise the failing tests"
Editors can attach over the Agent Client Protocol using fx acp, and libfx exposes the engine to JavaScript, including a WebAssembly build.
Early Hacker News feedback also probed the model-agnostic claim. Some first-run reports said setup appeared to route inference through Vercel AI Gateway, and commenters questioned how fx differed from established agents, pointing to OpenCode's more polished terminal experience.

articles.title: Pourquoi certains smartphones ne pourront bientôt plus faire tourner l'application Revolut
articles.summary:
Après une panne de grande envergure ce mardi 20 octobre, la banque en ligne Revolut est de nouveau sous le feu des projecteurs. Le compte X (Twitter) de Webologie a remarqué que les conditions générales de la néo-banque allaient changer.
La nouvelle clause figure dans les conditions générales de Revolut Bank S.A., l’entité bancaire française de Revolut, vers laquelle la néo-banque transfère les comptes de ses clients français. Cette version s’applique à partir du 2 décembre 2026.
Parmi les ajouts, une ligne qui confirme la position de l’établissement à l’encontre des systèmes d’exploitation alternatifs pour smartphone comme GrapheneOS. Les équipes de ce dernier accusent Revolut de bloquer son application sur leur OS depuis le 6 août 2026. Ce n’est visiblement pas près de s’arranger.
L’application Revolut seulement utilisable sur un appareil dont l’OS n’a pas été modifié
Au point 5 des nouvelles conditions générales, intitulé « Comment obtenir des informations sur les paiements depuis et vers mon compte ? », on trouve la mention suivante : « Pour utiliser l’application Revolut, recevoir nos communications et garantir la sécurité de votre compte et de vos données, votre appareil mobile doit répondre à certaines exigences techniques et logicielles ».
Parmi les trois points cités, l’un d’eux dispose que vous devez « utiliser le système d’exploitation d’origine de votre appareil, pris en charge par le fabricant ». Pas de root, de jailbreak ou de ROM custom donc. C’est le cas aussi…

articles.title: Tom Skerritt, estrella de 'Alien' y 'Top Gun', ha muerto a los 93 años
articles.summary:
Tom Skerritt, uno de los actores más prolíficos y reconocibles de Hollywood, dueño de una carrera que se extendió por más de 60 años, ha fallecido a los 93 años. El actor es especialmente recordado por sus roles en películas como M*A*S*H (1970), Alien (1979), Top Gun (1986), The Rookie (1990) y El río de la vida (1992), por solo citar algunos títulos de su extensa filmografía.
Según reporta Variety, Tom Skerritt falleció por causas naturales. Su deceso se produjo ayer, 21 de octubre, pero recién en la jornada de hoy se hizo público. El intérprete tuvo cinco hijos producto de tres matrimonios diferentes.
La carrera de Tom Skerritt no solo incluyó un gran número de películas, sino que sus trabajos en televisión fueron también muy destacados. En los años sesenta y setenta interpretó a múltiples personajes en títulos como Combat!, The Virginian, Death Valley Days, 12 O'Clock High, Gunsmoke y The FBI.
Sin embargo, su rol televisivo más conocido y recordado fue el del Sheriff Jimmy Brock en Picket Fences (1992 a 1996). Su trabajo en dicha serie le valió un Premio Emmy y dos nominaciones a los Globos de Oro.
Muere Tom Skerritt, un ícono del cine y la TV
Claro que los roles que lo hicieron mundialmente famoso estuvieron en el cine. Alien fue el primer gran papel que le dio reconocimiento internacional a Tom Skerritt, interpretando a Arthur Dallas, capitán del Nostromo. Otro papel icónico le llegó en 1986, de la mano de Top Gun, cuando dio vida al comandante Mike Metcalf, alias Viper.…

Four years ago, a senior official in Russia’s foreign ministry painted a bullseye on commercial satellite networks that assist Ukraine in its fight against invading Russian military forces.
On Wednesday, several days after a Russian military spacecraft moved within striking distance of one of those commercial satellites, the same Russian diplomat assured the world there’s no reason to worry.

The decision to conduct these activities was deliberately reckless and violated long-established safety thresholds in low-Earth orbit.”

articles.title: Canva releases its first image generation model | TechCrunch
articles.summary:
Design platform Canva released its first image generation model, called Canva Craft, developed by its research team to compete with same-category models from Google, OpenAI, ByteDance, and Meta.
The company said its model works in two stages. In the first stage, it interprets users’ prompts and creates a plan with details like spatial relationships of elements, relative scale, visual hierarchy, and information for text generation. In the second stage, its model generates an image of up to 2K resolution in a possible 30 different aspect ratios for various platforms.
Canva said that this approach allows it to create images with accurate details of objects and legible text. Plus, users would be able to make precise edits without changing other parts of the image.
The company noted that rather than using photographs, it used designs to train this model using human-designed templates from Canva’s library, including posters, social posts, presentations, infographics, menus, and typography-rich layouts.
That means images generated with Canva Craft could be converted into layered designs using Canva Magic, the company’s image-to-design transformer. Last year, the platform released its own model that understands designs and layers.

articles.title: Hacker Conversations: Corey Thuen and the Evil Bit
articles.summary:
Corey Thuen is a hacker with a hacker mindset that is focused on the right way to do wrong things to get the right result.
Corey Thuen is the founder and CEO of Gravwell, a firm with a slight difference: it develops data analytics and vulnerability detection through a combined team of big data experts and hackers.
When interviewing a candidate for the hacker half of the team, he looks for people who have what he calls ‘the evil bit’. “Do they have that ‘evil streak’? Do they have that adversarial mindset that can look at a product and seek out ways to exploit it? If they don’t have that evil bit, I don’t think we can teach it.” He accepts that it may be possible for some people to develop one, but in his own experience, it’s either there or it’s not. Natural-born hacker is more a fact than a description; and it is tempting to describe Thuen as a natural-born hacker himself.
But does ‘evil’ indicate a lack of morality? “Who defines morality?” he replied. “Who defines what is good and what is bad? The old school hacking ethos, which still lingers, is that all information should be free”. Other folks consider that a bad viewpoint.
“I was recently working for the US government. We were evaluating the systems that go into power substations, part of the critical infrastructure. So, we were hacking these systems, but the goal was to improve security for everyone. We were using the evil streak for good. Hacking skills are a bit like guns. Neither are evil in themselves. articles.title: OpenAI donates Open Responses, its spec for a common LLM API, to the Agentic AI Foundation
articles.summary:
OpenAI donates Open Responses, its spec for a common LLM API, to the Agentic AI Foundation
OpenAI on Thursday announced that it is donating the Open Responses API specification to the open source Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF).
In addition to Open Responses, OpenSandbox, Anthropic’s Agent Skills, and HuggingFace’s OpenEv framework for agent environments are also joining the AAIF.
The join other AAIF projects like the MCP and A2A protocols, AGENTS.md (also from OpenAI), the open source AI agent goose, agentgateway, and Agent Router. The foundation, which is part of the Linux Foundation, launched in December 2025, with MCP, goose, and AGENTS.md as its first projects.
As for Open Responses, the core idea here is to provide developers with a set of core API calls that should work across LLM providers. When OpenAI first announced the specification in January, the team behind the project noted that virtually all LLM providers now offer the same building blocks (messages, tool calls, function calling, etc.), but that they also all represent them differently in their APIs.
Open Responses aims to create a spec that standardizes these primitives so that developers don’t have to translate between each vendor’s idiosyncratic API when they switch between models.

articles.title: PEGI is giving games with paid loot boxes a PEGI 16 rating, and EA FC 27 is the first big example
articles.summary:
Editor's take: The Europe-based PEGI rating system is introducing a significant change in how games sold across the Old Continent are labelled and marketed to consumers. Digital-only titles designed to sell gamers random items for a pretty penny now face the same rating risks as games depicting violence, sexual activity, and drug use. As they should.
Earlier this year, the Pan-European Game Information (PEGI) system announced a new rating regime for video games built around selling randomized content to players. Now, the organization responsible for administering PEGI in the United Kingdom has confirmed that the changes are finally being implemented. Major game releases have already been affected by the new ratings, although the new rules are expected to remain exclusive to Europe.
According to a recent post by Connor Hinde, who serves as a PEGI administrator in the UK, the Games Rating Authority (GRA) has begun applying the new PEGI rating criteria. A number of previously released, digital-only games will be affected, starting with titles that employ aggressive monetization tactics, such as loot boxes and other systems involving randomized rewards.
A game such as EA Sports FC 27, which previously carried a PEGI 3 rating – meaning it was considered suitable for all ages – has now been assigned a PEGI 16 rating. The new classification includes the "Paid Random Items" descriptor, informing consumers and parents that these games may carry additional financial risks associated wi…

articles.title: Railway warns devs to rotate secrets after potential breach
articles.summary:
Cloud hosting provider Railway published an urgent warning to users after detecting suspicious activity on its systems that store customer environment variables earlier this week.
The company says its investigation indicates that, in some cases, an unauthorized third party may have obtained decrypted variables and urges all users to proactively rotate secrets and credentials.
“Our investigation to date indicates that an unauthorized third party may have accessed encrypted environment variables and, for some of them, obtained the decrypted contents,” Railway says.
“Environment variables may contain secrets such as API keys or database and registry credentials,” the company clarifies.
Railway is a cloud platform for developers to deploy and run applications, APIs, databases, and various backend services. It has around 4.8 million users and hosts more than 16 million services.
The service stores deployment-related configuration settings and credentials in environment variables, which the incident exposed.
Railway says the incident was part of a series of attacks targeting AI inference providers, which were notified directly and advised to revoke all their keys as a precaution.
AI inference providers are services that run AI models and return answers to Railway-hosted applications.
Although initial analysis suggests only a subset of users may be affected, Railway urges all users to immediately rotate environment variables and secrets stored on the platform, including private regi…

articles.title: 9 Minuten Laden, 90 Minuten Arbeit: Neue Akkus sollen den Digits 5 zum echten Haushaltshelfer machen

9 Minuten laden für 90 Minuten Arbeit: Wie neue Akkus humanoide Roboter alltagstauglich machen
Der humanoide Roboter Digit 5 von Agility Robotics hat eine besonders lange Laufzeit bei kurzem Aufladen. Die Batterietechnik dafür liefert das Unternehmen Nyobolt. Damit kommt der Roboter auf ein Verhältnis von Laufzeit zu Ladezeit von ungefähr 10:1. Für jede Minute an der Ladestation stehen also zehn Minuten Arbeit zur Verfügung. Lädt man neun Minuten, läuft der Humanoid 90 Minuten. Der Vorgänger Digit 4 schaffte lediglich ein Verhältnis von 2:1 – er verbrachte rund ein Drittel des Tages am Ladegerät.
Warum Akkus bei Humanoiden das Hauptproblem sind
Humanoide Roboter brauchen viel Strom. Weil sie sich frei bewegen sollen, kommt der aus Batterien. Die halten allerdings nicht lange und müssen regelmäßig nachgeladen oder getauscht werden. Agility Robotics setzt deshalb auf besonders leichte Akkus mit hoher Leistungsdichte, die also viel Energie pro Kilogramm abgeben können.
Mit der neuen Technik könne Digit 5 täglich mehr als zwei komplette Arbeitsschichten absolvieren, teilt Agility Robotics mit. Die Auslastung einer Roboterflotte im Unternehmen steige dadurch deutlich. Die Akkus von Nyobolt sollen zudem viele Ladezyklen überstehen. Konkrete Zahlen nannten allerdings weder Agility Robotics noch Nyobolt: Weder zur Kapazität noch zur Zahl der möglichen Ladevorgänge gibt es Angaben.

Without clear governance, AI puts companies at risk of reputational damage

CTO & Co-Founder at Ravical.
Cybersecurity isn’t a new issue for business leaders, but its significance is increasing in the age of AI. Clients trust them with information, employees don’t want to disclose their salaries or investors don’t want to make their investments public.

AI presents great opportunities to speed up repetitive tasks, like data reporting, leaving more time for employees to produce more strategic, quality work for clients. articles.title: Micron pulls the plug on future 4F² DRAM after two decades of research in dramatic shift — company says architecture offers no meaningful density advantages, increases manufacturing complexity and costs, and has fundamental scaling limitations
articles.summary:
Micron pulls the plug on future 4F² DRAM after two decades of research in dramatic shift — company says architecture offers no meaningful density advantages, increases manufacturing complexity and costs, and has fundamental scaling limitations
Micron goes against the industry?
DRAM featuring 4F² memory cells has long been considered one of the holy grails of the DRAM industry, as they promise to reduce cell area by 33% compared with conventional 6F² designs and therefore enable building DRAMs with more memory cells in the same area. However, after working on 4F² memory cells for a couple of decades, Micron has concluded that the architecture offers no meaningful density advantages, increases manufacturing complexity and costs, and has fundamental scaling limitations. This has a dramatic impact on Micron's future plans.
"Micron invented 4F² DRAM," said Scott DeBoer, president and chief technology and products officer at Micron, during the company's event on Wednesday. "The path with 4F² DRAM is always been an option through time, and we have evaluated it and not pursued it due to increased complexity and cost through this past two-decade period of time."
Interestingly, both Samsung and SK hynix still have 4F² memory cells in their roadmaps (according to TechInsights), so Micron's rejection of the technology puts the company on a unique trajectory. articles.title: 1Password launches a way for AI agents to log in on your behalf without seeing your password | TechCrunch
articles.summary:
Concerns have swirled over the access that consumers are increasingly entrusting to AI agents. Now, security services are trying to catch up.
Password manager 1Password on Thursday launched a new tool by which users can allow agents to log into their personal accounts on their behalf, without the agent ever having access to a user’s credentials.
The new platform, dubbed 1Password for Agents, accomplishes this by creating a system of communication between the agent, the user, and the password manager. When an agent attempts to log in on a user’s behalf, a unique digital key is sent to 1Password to confirm the agent’s digital identity. The user is then sent an alert about the login attempt and can personally confirm the request. 1Password then signs in the agent, filling in the credentials on the digital assistant’s behalf, which allows it to log in and complete whatever task is at hand.
1Password for Agents allows users to choose their agent of choice — whether that’s Claude Duet from Anthropic, OpenAI’s Dots or ChatGPT Work, Grok Bot, Meta’s Muse, or agents from Town, which is an AI assistant startup. The company says it is working with other companies to expand the service.
“Handing over a password, secret, or credential is a common shortcut to an agent, but can leave people with sensitive information in places they can no longer control as a copy gets saved for the next time,” the company said in a blog post. “1Password for Agents gives people a trusted way to delegate task…

AI budgets are under pressure
- One in two CIOs expect to miss their AI ROI targets in 2027
- AI budgets are rising, but not enough to keep up with inflation
- A quantum computing breakthrough could put further strain on budgets
New research has claimed AI is set to account for a fifth of all business technology spend in 2027 as companies invest more in thought-out deployments.
However, despite the fact that experimentation is evolving into meaningful adoption, more than half of the CIOs surveyed in Forrester's latest State Of AI Survey 2026 expect to miss their AI ROI targets next year.
The report also details what it means for AI to be considered a success – around half (45%) of CIOs prefer to see an ROI within one year to consider their rollouts a success.
AI still isn't delivering promised ROI
Over the last year, just one in five (22%) AI decision makers have reported a positive impact on their earnings.
Looking ahead, Forrester predicts that businesses will finally become better at linking their AI investments to actual financial outcomes.
All of this, of course, comes amid ongoing financial pressures. Although most tech leaders expect to increase their budgets next year, just one in two (53%) expect this to be above inflation, meaning many are just struggling to keep up with rising costs.

Claude ganha agente 24×7 para brigar com ChatGPT, Google e Meta
Claude Duet tem navegador próprio para acessar a internet. Novidade está em fase de teste.
A Anthropic revelou o Claude Duet, novo sistema de IA que funciona como um agente pessoal que trabalha 24 horas por dia. Ele promete organizar a rotina e otimizar o tempo das pessoas. O anúncio ocorreu nesta quarta-feira (21/10).

Estas ferramentas criam resumos e fazem sugestões baseadas nas suas atividades digitais.

O lançamento do Claude Duet marca a entrada da Anthropic no ramo das IAs agênticas que funcionam 24×7, focadas em ações autônomas no dia a dia. articles.title: Study Finds AI-generated Code Fails to Boost Productivity Due to Downstream Bottlenecks
articles.summary:
A recent Harvard study of 718 firms, using the Jellyfish analytics platform, finds that although AI coding assistants and agents increase code volume, this does not translate into a corresponding increase in completed work, partly because AI-generated code increases the workload in later stages of development, particularly code review.
The study was based on approximately 300 million work events of 700,000 workers across 700+ firms from January 2021 to March 2026. The data was gathered from several sources such as HR information, code version control systems, issue management systems, scheduling tools such as Google Calendar, and generative-AI tools, including GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and Claude Code.
The researchers considered three measures of coding output: lines of code added, commits, and pull requests.
AI assistants lead to small increases in code output — 12% for lines of code, 9% for commits, and 5% for pull requests — with only the effect on commits being statistically significant. AI agents lead to large and significant increases in all three measures: 30% for lines of code, 20% for commits, and 23% for pull requests.
The authors used these data to evaluate software output by the number of Jira issues and epics resolved per worker per month, with issues treated as individual units of engineering work, and epics as larger projects or features. Ramp built an AI agent harness in six weeks — and LangChain’s CEO says it’s part of a bigger shift

The result is Laminar, an internal agent harness that took six weeks to reach a first version and now powers every agentic product at the fintech company.
“We studied the other offerings on the market and decided that we could do better, move faster, and have stronger alignment to where we want to go by building in house.”
“We studied the other offerings on the market and decided that we could do better, move faster, and have stronger alignment to where we want to go by building in house,” Sam Kronick, the Ramp engineer behind the platform, writes in the company’s engineering blog.

The architecture caught the attention of LangChain CEO Harrison Chase, who praised several design choices in his X post, while pointing to similar work underway in LangChain’s Deep Agents.
Ramp and LangChain are approaching the problem from different directions, but both point to a bigger shift in agent infrastructure. As harnesses take on more responsibility, enterprises have to decide how much of that infrastructure they want to build and maintain themselves.

articles.title: Windows 11 optimiert RAM-Verbrauch: So gut läuft das System jetzt auf einem PC mit 8 Gigabyte
articles.summary:
Windows 11 optimiert RAM-Verbrauch: So gut läuft das System jetzt auf einem PC mit 8 Gigabyte
Seit August 2026 arbeitet Microsoft daran, Windows 11 effizienter zu gestalten. Damals hatte das Unternehmen versprochen, dass gerade Geräte mit acht Gigabyte RAM davon stark profitieren sollen. Wie genau diese Speicheroptimierung aussehen sollte, verriet das Unternehmen damals noch nicht. Jetzt zeigen sich aber schon die ersten Auswirkungen. Seit dem Update auf Windows 11 26H2 verbrauchen die besagten Systeme deutlich weniger RAM.
Windows 11 26H2: So gut funktioniert die RAM-Optimierung
Den Test dazu hat Windows Latest zunächst mit zwei Windows-Geräten durchgeführt. Eines davon lief noch mit der „alten“ 25H2-Version von Windows 11, das andere mit 26H2. Die ältere Systemversion benötigte im normalen Gebrauch schon etwas mehr als fünf Gigabyte der vorhandenen acht Gigabyte RAM. Nach dem Update auf Version 26H2 sank der Arbeitsspeicherverbrauch auf 3,3 Gigabyte.
In einem zweiten Test wurde Windows 11 in einer virtuellen Maschine installiert. So, als hätten User:innen das System komplett neu aufgesetzt. In diesem Zustand verbrauchte das Windows-System mit dem Oktober-Update von 25H2 rund 4,1 Gigabyte Arbeitsspeicher während des Normalbetriebs. Nach dem Update für die virtuelle Maschine lief das System mit einem RAM-Verbrauch zwischen 2,8 und 3,2 Gigabyte.

articles.summary:
The federal government shared hotly anticipated details on how a $1.75-billion CAD commitment would be distributed to the Canadian venture capital industry in Toronto today.
While Canada’s VC investors largely welcomed the announcement, some cautioned that they’d still like to see more financial support for the country’s early-stage startups, while others wondered how much longer they would still have to wait for the new funding to trickle down into the market.
The VC strategy includes two main tenets: $750 million for the Early and Growth Stage Investment Strategy, and $1 billion for the Growth Venture Capital Catalyst Initiative (Growth VCCI), the fourth and largest iteration of the government’s VC program.
“All stages are important, but the added emphasis on growth was what was missing.”
John Ruffolo
Maverix Private Equity
Industry groups had competing ideas for how the $750-million envelope should be allocated. The National Angel Capital Organization (NACO) had wanted funds funnelled to the earliest stages, while the Canadian Venture Capital & Private Equity Association (CVCA) had argued the envelope should be targeted to growth companies at the Series B stage and beyond. The Canadian Startup Capital Association (CSCA) was somewhere in the middle, asking the feds to allocate 10 to 20 percent to pre-seed and seed stages, with the remainder to growth.

articles.title: Bruxelles ouvre une enquête sur les pratiques de Booking.com
articles.summary:
La Commission européenne soupçonne Booking.com de ne pas avoir évalué avec sérieux, ni réduit efficacement, les risques d’annonces frauduleuses et de phishing. Les autorités européennes vérifient aussi que les logements mis en avant contre paiement sont bien présentés comme des publicités.
La Commission européenne a ouvert hier une procédure formelle contre Booking.com au titre du règlement sur les services numériques (DSA). Trois sujets sont passés au crible : les fausses annonces, les arnaques qui exploitent les données de réservation et les annonces« boostées ».
Fausses annonces, messagerie détournée, publicités floues : ce que Bruxelles veut vérifier
Booking.com est classée VLOP (Very Large Online Platform) depuis le 25 avril 2023, un statut réservé aux plateformes de plus de 45 millions d’utilisateurs dans l’UE. Les articles 34 et 35 du DSA lui imposent d’identifier régulièrement les risques que son service peut créer, de les évaluer, puis de les réduire. Il y a tout d'abord les fausses inscriptions (logements inexistants, usurpation d’identité, hébergements non conformes). Selon The Register, la Commission vise notamment des personnes qui se font passer pour le propriétaire d’un bien qu’elles ne possèdent pas.
Le deuxième sujet concerne le phishing. La Commission regarde comment les données de réservation et d’invité sont partagées avec les hébergeurs, comment la messagerie de Booking.com est conçue, et si des garde-fous empêchent leur détournement. Elle soupçonne aussi…

articles.summary:
Fondé en 1995 à Edmonton, le studio légendaire derrière Baldur’s Gate, Neverwinter Nights, Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic, Mass Effect et Dragon Age a officialisé la nouvelle sur les réseaux sociaux. Cette annonce tombe quelques minutes seulement après la publication d’un rapport de Bloomberg détaillant les suppressions de postes, dont 50 touchent directement les équipes de BioWare. Les dirigeants d’EA justifient ces coupes par la nécessité « d’aligner les talents et les investissements là où se trouvent les plus grandes opportunités de croissance ».
La chute d’un pilier du jeu de rôle
Racheté par Electronic Arts en 2007, le studio était autrefois qualifié par l’ancien PDG John Riccitiello de l’une des structures les plus respectées de l’industrie. Mais le rachat d’EA l’an dernier pour 55 milliards de dollars par un consortium comprenant Silver Lake, le fonds souverain saoudien et Affinity Partners a lourdement endetté l’entreprise. Les analystes prévoyaient déjà de telles mesures, la nouvelle direction privilégiant les services en ligne, les jeux de sport annuels et les microtransactions au détriment des studios narratifs.
Les difficultés s’étaient accumulées ces dernières années avec le départ de figures historiques, comme les fondateurs Ray Muzyka et Greg Zeschuk en 2012, ou encore Casey Hudson et Mac Walters. CureBay raises Rs 100 Cr in Pre-Series C round led by IvyCap Ventures
CureBay said it will use the funds to expand its operations across India, strengthen its healthcare delivery network, and develop its technology and AI capabilities.
Rural healthcare platform CureBay has raised Rs 100 crore in a Pre-Series C funding round led by IvyCap Ventures.
The round includes Rs 69 crore in equity from IvyCap Ventures and existing investors, along with over Rs 30 crore in debt from Trifecta Capital, Alteria Capital and VentureSoul Partners.
CureBay said it will use the funds to expand its operations across India, strengthen its healthcare delivery network, and develop its technology and AI capabilities. These include its Intelligence Layer, which is designed to support patient screening, health insights and clinical decision-making.
Founded in 2021 by Priyadarshi Mohapatra, Shobhan Mahapatra and Sanjay Swain, CureBay operates a technology-enabled rural healthcare network combining physical clinics with digital services. Its model includes IoT-enabled clinics, a network of Swasthya Mitras, a connected digital platform, AI-powered screening and risk alerts, a 24/7 command centre, and CureBay Kavach.
The company operates more than 250 technology-enabled clinics across seven states. It said it has served over 17 lakh patients and conducts more than 400 health camps each month.

articles.title: Bitchat mesh : pourquoi la messagerie sans Internet de Jack Dorsey cartonne
articles.summary:
D’ordinaire, les tops des applications les plus populaires sont accaparés par les gros réseaux sociaux (comme Facebook), les messageries instantanées (Signal, WhatsApp, Telegram), par des apps de discussion (Discord) ou par des outils administratifs (compte Améli, France Identité). Voilà d’ailleurs à quoi ressemble le gros du classement de l’App Store.
Mais voilà, du changement vient d’être observé ces jours-ci. Comme l’a noté un journaliste de BFM TV le 22 octobre 2026, une application a grimpé presque tout en haut de cette hiérarchie. En France, elle s’est même imposée à la première place de la catégorie « réseaux sociaux » et positionnée dans le top 10 général de toutes les applications.
Son nom ? Bitchat Mesh. Curieusement, c’est une application qui n’est pas du tout nouvelle. Ses notes de mise à jour montrent qu’elle existe depuis le 28 juillet 2025. Comment expliquer une telle remontada dans le classement de l’App Store ? Peut-être cela a-t-il à voir à la fois avec le contexte sociopolitique français… et avec la nature de l’application elle-même.
Car Bitchat Mesh, qui est déclinée aussi bien pour iOS que pour Android via Google Play, a une particularité : c’est une application qui permet de discuter avec des gens autour de soi sans compte, sans numéro de téléphone, sans adresse e-mail et sans connexion Internet. En ese momento es cuando se empezará a excavar un segundo túnel. Cuando éste se termine será cuando cada uno de ellos pueda ser utilizado para cada sentido de la circulación.

In a piece published on The Conversation, Adam Kenneth Dubé, associate professor of Learning Sciences at McGill’s Faculty of Education, wrote about some of the harmful effects that he’s been studying.
As he explains, new worldwide data on 15-year-olds’ science, math and reading ability was released last month by OECD’s Program for International Student Assessment (PISA). In Canada, 24,600 students from 897 schools took part, with this year’s report focusing on their use of AI in learning.
Notably, the report found that 86 per cent of teens globally use AI for school, and Canadian teens who use AI every week for school scored two years behind those who never use it. Dubé adds that scores have overall been declining for years, coinciding with the 2022 release of ChatGPT, although he stresses that this in itself isn’t evidence of causality.
Instead, he looked further into how and why Canadian students are turning to AI. Here were some of the biggest use cases:
- “To help me learn” (38 per cent in Canada, 46 per cent globally)
- To research new topics (23 per cent in Canada, 31 per cent globally)
- To summarize a reading (23 per cent in Canada, 30 per cent globally)
- To generate texts for assignments (18 per cent in Canada, 29 per cent globally)

articles.title: Five AI agent harnesses took the same memory test. The results weren't even close.
articles.summary:
Five AI agent harnesses took the same memory test. The results weren’t even close.
AI agents are getting better at remembering past conversations and earlier tasks but remembering something doesn’t guarantee an agent can use it to do better work next time. Letta’s new FrontierMemory benchmark, released Wednesday, tests that gap by measuring whether agents can learn from experience rather than by just retrieving stored information. Early results show a widespread in performance across agent harnesses, the the infrastructure that manages how an agent operates.
Letta Dream came out on top with a 73.3% score, followed by Prime Agent at 60%. OpenAI Agents SDK scored 40%, while Claude Managed Agents and Hermes Agent trailed at 33.3% and 26.7%, respectively.
Recall isn’t learning
“Modern ‘memory’ benchmarks are saturated since they measure recall of facts,” Letta co-founder and CEO Charles Packer writes on X, saying that in the coding harness and bash loop era, recall is solved, while continual learning in token space, meaning learning through the context an agent keeps rather than through weight updates, remains unsolved.
Sarah Wooders, also a Letta co-founder, points to another problem on X. Most coding and knowledge-work benchmarks evaluate unrelated tasks with all the necessary context provided upfront. articles.title: The secret to fast startup growth isn't early sales, top names in tech say | TechCrunch
articles.summary:
The AI era has changed how fast startups can grow. Startups can grow so fast that they hit high annual recurring revenue (ARR) numbers, only to crash and burn a few months later. At this year’s TechCrunch Disrupt, Lovable go-to-market lead Luke Arno, Ben Broca of the AI platform Polsia, and Theory Ventures’ Tomasz Tunguz gave founders some tips on how to set their companies up for success in those first 90 days.
Broca, whose company Polsia uses AI agents to build and run businesses with almost no human staff (Broca says he is its only employee), said that product-market fit is one of the hardest things to find right now, especially in an era when so many products can easily be copied by competitors. In response, Arno said that durable go-to-market strategies are those that can be reliably repeated.
“The most critical thing for founders or earlier-stage companies to do is develop learning density or pattern recognition for where your customers are,” Arno said. “Don’t rush to build out a top-down go-to-market motion if you’re not there yet.”
That’s why, in those first 90 days after launching a commercial product that’s ready to sell, founders should not mistake early, fast revenue for a sign that the startup is ready to scale, Arno said.
Once a startup finds use cases that work, it will only be ready to build out a sales team and go for growth after it can attract new customers by repeating what has worked. If every sale requires new tactics, the startup hasn’t truly hit produc…

Un équipement du nouveau cœur de réseau en cause

articles.title: Can AI make debt collections less about chasing and more about predicting?
articles.summary:
Can AI make debt collections less about chasing and more about predicting?
The future lies in using data to understand portfolios, AI to prioritise decisions, and human judgement where individual circumstances matter most.
Defaults are inevitable.
For the past few years, we have been hearing about predictive analytics that can identify a borrower who is going to default before the default actually happens.
Time and again, we have seen the limits of this idea.
Defaults aren't a prediction problem that technology will eventually eliminate. Defaults are an uncertainty that lending produces, by design. What lenders need is not machinery that assumes this uncertainty can be removed, but machinery designed to operate effectively under it.
You cannot predict at an individual borrower level who is going to default. You can, at best, predict, over a sufficiently large cohort of borrowers, what the default rate might be.
The behaviour of large groups can be predicted statistically. The behaviour of a particular individual cannot.
If you have one million borrowers, you can make remarkably good statements about what will happen to the portfolio. Narrow it to 100,000 borrowers in Karnataka, and you can still make useful predictions. Narrow it further by repayment history, geography, employment, credit score and other risk characteristics, and you can create increasingly meaningful cohorts.
But as the cohorts get smaller, the certainty of those predictions starts decreasing.

Stop everything and update your browsers, OSes, development tools, and routers.
Most everyone in the tech space has been living in interesting times, but this week isn't done yet, and it's already quite special for systems administrators worldwide. They already had to deal with the critical PHP RCE vulnerability, but they also have to update untold amounts of machines and software, thanks to eight insecure intermediate CA certificates that can allow attackers to impersonate any domain and/or pretend their malware is from a legitimate source.
An attacker anywhere in the path of your network traffic, like, say, in a company or government network, public Wi-Fi, your ISP, or one of any number of government entities, can intercept your connection and pretend that they're any website, like apple.com, amazon.com, or bankofamerica.com. articles.title: Nvidia driver update should greatly speed up PC games
articles.summary:
Nvidia has rolled out a new GPU driver that should significantly speed up game launches.
The update, 621.01, adds Microsoft’s new Advanced Shader Delivery tech to reduce the load on CPUs by offloading the heavy lifting to the cloud. As Nvidia notes, modern games rely on tens of thousands of complex shaders as well as generic shader files that result in a slow, CPU-heavy process that can take up to 30 minutes.
But with Microsoft’s latest tech, the cloud network can greatly cut down these wait times by precompiling shaders for hundreds of thousands of hardware and driver combinations. It also removes mid-game “just-in-time” shader compilation that can cause CPU spikes and frame stutters.
For now, this week’s Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 and the recently released Gears of War: E-Day from Vancouver’s The Coalition support Advanced Shader Delivery. You’ll need to download these games via the Xbox PC app, but from there, you’ll benefit from the new shader system even when playing Steam games as long as the Xbox app remains installed.
The 621.01 update can be downloaded here. The new GPU driver comes as part of a larger series of updates to improve gaming on Nvidia GeForce. The full breakdown can be found on Nvidia’s blog.
Image credit: Activision

articles.title: Ink droplets in motion snag top prize in Nikon Small World contest
articles.summary:
A 25-year-old German experimental photographer has won the 2026 Nikon Small World photomicrography competition with a striking image of droplets of ink being deposited on paper by an inkjet printer. Ole Bielfeldt beat out 1,802 other entries hailing from 69 different countries.
Bielfeldt became interested in photomicrography during the COVID-19 lockdown after discovering an old microscope in his parents’ attic. He figured out how to build an adaptor out of a tube and some wood to connect the microscope to his father’s camera and taught himself the art through trial and error, building custom tools as needed. He documents how he captures transformative images of everyday objects with behind-the-scenes videos posted to macrofying, his photography and videography brand.
It was Bielfeldt’s curiosity about the inner workings of inkjet printers that inspired his winning entry, but capturing the action of ink drops being deposited on paper was a challenge, given that the process happens so quickly. The droplets, for instance, moved faster than the camera’s shutter speed. Bielfeldt’s solution was to deconstruct the printer so that the paper moved under a stationary (rather than moving) printhead, and then take the image in a dark room, using a flash to serve as the shutter, thereby freezing the ink drops mid-air. There was no need for pricey equipment. Bielfeldt does not use AI in his images, preferring to rely on traditional techniques.

Lo que no está claro es qué ocurre con ese dinero cuando llega al bolsillo del camarero: si Hacienda lo ve, si hay que declararlo o si la empresa tiene que cotizar por él. O, como hacía mi antiguo jefe, si mete mano en el bote y se las guarda, ¿se puede reclamar?
Para Hacienda. Empecemos con lo que dice la Agencia Tributaria. Como recoge elEconomista, la Administración obliga a tributar todas las cantidades que los empleados reciben como propinas. Sí, igual que un salario. La base es el artículo 17.1 de la ley del IRPF, que considera rendimientos del trabajo las contraprestaciones derivadas del trabajo personal o de la relación laboral. La Dirección General de Tributos aplica ese criterio en sus consultas vinculantes. Da igual que el dinero lo ponga un cliente por voluntad propia: hay que incluirlo en la declaración.
Y no es nuevo. Las propinas no están reguladas de forma específica en nuestro ordenamiento, más allá de lo que algunos convenios colectivos dicen sobre su gestión y reparto. El tratamiento fiscal sale de la interpretación de Hacienda, que lleva años manteniendo el mismo criterio.

articles.title: Affaire Thélyson Orélien : les métadonnées de son roman changent la donne
articles.summary:
Après des semaines de soupçons alimentés notamment par les détecteurs de textes générés par IA, l’affaire Thélyson Orélien prend une nouvelle tournure. Les Éditions du Boréal affirment avoir retrouvé des traces liées à l’intelligence artificielle dans les métadonnées de plusieurs documents de travail de C’était ça ou mourir. Un élément d’une autre nature qu’un score Pangram, mais qui ne dit toujours pas précisément quel rôle l’IA a joué dans l’écriture du roman.
Publié au Québec au printemps 2026 puis chez Grasset en France le 19 août, C’était ça ou mourir est devenu l’un des romans les plus remarqués de la rentrée littéraire. Le 21 septembre, quelques heures après l’attribution du Prix du Roman Fnac, le compte « Balance ton Claude » publiait plusieurs analyses réalisées avec Pangram suggérant qu’une large partie du livre pouvait avoir été générée par intelligence artificielle. Thélyson Orélien a toujours contesté cette accusation
Des traces retrouvées dans les versions de travail du roman
Dans un communiqué publié le 21 octobre, les Éditions du Boréal annoncent mettre fin à leur collaboration avec l’écrivain et renoncer à réimprimer son roman. La maison québécoise affirme désormais que l’intelligence artificielle a bien été utilisée au cours du processus d’écriture.
Après plusieurs semaines passées à tenter de documenter la création du livre avec l’auteur, l’éditeur explique avoir rassemblé l’ensemble des versions de travail disponibles et commandé une analyse externe approf…

He talks of his frustration with military life—“by the time you put out one fire, another had already started”—before discussing his new line of work “stopping [the fires] before they start” and “making the choices no one else is willing to make. articles.title: Nintendo Switch 2 jailbreaking is here, with homebrew, modding, and reverse engineering
articles.summary:
The big picture: AI coding has unleashed a new wave of decompilations and jailbreaks, largely centered on video games. Modders cracked almost every PlayStation 5 firmware version a few weeks ago, and the Nintendo Switch 2 is next. The phenomenon could lead to a repeat of the original Switch's piracy problem, but Nintendo has already responded.
The Nintendo Switch 2's first public jailbreak is now in the wild. Unfortunately, anyone who hasn't already bought the coding tool SmileBASIC 4 for the Switch is out of luck, as it has already disappeared from the Nintendo eShop.
Researcher and modder Sammy Hajhamid successfully cracked Switch 2 firmware version 23.0.1, ran homebrew software, accessed most of the device's peripherals, and backed up save files. He demonstrated his progress with footage of a modded version of Mario Kart World featuring Goku, Walter White, Peter Griffin, Hatsune Miku, Gold Ship, and other famous non-Nintendo characters.
 – pepsipu (@pepsipu) October 22, 2026
While it's usually Claude driving the AI reverse-engineering craze, Hajhamid used OpenAI's Codex instead. He used it to vibe-code the Mario Kart mod, but the jailbreak itself took about two weeks.
The exploit works entirely through software, so it doesn't require hardware modifications. However, Hajhamid hasn't devised a full-blown custom firmware yet, so the hack must be repeated each time the handheld-console hybrid reboots, and it requires a computer.

articles.title: “Nuestra humanidad corre peligro”: advertencia de una profesora del MIT contra la dependencia emocional de la IA
articles.summary:
La investigadora Sherry Turkle, profesora del Instituto Tecnológico de Massachusetts (MIT), advirtió que la dependencia emocional hacia los chatbots pone en riesgo la humanidad de quienes recurren a ellos como sustitutos de las relaciones personales.
En una entrevista con la revista Wired, la académica presentó los argumentos centrales de su nuevo libro, ‘Artificial Intimacy: Who We Become When We Talk to Machines’, en el que describe un estado de emergencia provocado por el uso creciente de máquinas que simulan ser tutores, amigos o parejas.
La advertencia proviene de una especialista que lleva cuatro décadas estudiando la relación entre personas y computadoras, reconocida por su enfoque académico y su distancia frente a posturas alarmistas. Turkle busca que su obra tenga el mismo impacto que libros considerados pioneros en advertir sobre crisis sociales, como Silent Spring, The Jungle o Unsafe at Any Speed, títulos que en su momento lograron movilizar a la opinión pública frente a riesgos poco visibles.
Una investigación que cambió su rumbo durante la pandemia
Turkle explicó que su nuevo libro surgió de una curiosidad similar a la de sus trabajos anteriores, pero que el proceso tomó un giro distinto después de las primeras entrevistas realizadas durante la pandemia. Según relató, varias personas con familias atravesando dificultades afirmaron que lo único que deseaban era pasar tiempo con su chatbot.

articles.title: Après la panne, Orange doit gérer un autre problème : plusieurs services sont suspendus à cause des failles PHP
articles.summary:
Orange traverse actuellement une forte période de turbulence. Ce mercredi 21 octobre, l’opérateur a été victime d’une panne majeure, privant une partie conséquente de ses clients de réseau. Contacté par nos soins, l’entreprise a expliqué que l’« incident technique a eu lieu sur un équipement de [son] nouveau cœur de réseau ». Orange a d’ailleurs annoncé faire un geste de dédommagement pour les clients touchés par la panne. À cette panne s’ajoutent deux failles PHP critiques qui touchent des centaines de millions de sites web à travers le monde. Une situation qui se révèle être un véritable casse-tête pour tout le monde, y compris Orange. En effet, l’opérateur a annoncé suspendre l’accès à certains de ses sites et à certaines applications utilisant PHP.
Orange annonce suspendre l’accès à certains de ses sites et applications
Dans un communiqué, Orange annonce « suspendre temporairement l’accès à certains sites et applications utilisant PHP ». L’objectif : éviter toute tentative de cyberattaque en coupant purement et simplement l’accès aux services concernés. L’opérateur explique que « cette décision a permis de déployer les correctifs de sécurité nécessaires et de réaliser les vérifications associées avant la remise en service progressive des sites et applications ». Les correctifs auraient déjà été déployés sur une grande partie des sites concernés.

TSMC is seeking chipmaking equipment that doesn't contain Chinese rare-earth magnets — asks suppliers to provide alternative motors as export controls threaten fab operations
China accounts for 95% of finished permanent magnets
TSMC, the world's largest contract chip manufacturer, is seeking alternative machinery without rare-earth components to reduce its dependence on China-dominated materials and avoid disruptions to factory operations caused by the country's export controls. According to a Reuters report on October 22 citing people familiar with the matter, the Taiwanese company has begun approaching its equipment suppliers to explore whether they can provide factory automation equipment equipped with motors that don't require rare-earth materials.
TSMC supplies the extremely powerful Nvidia chips that are facilitating the AI boom. It also manufactures chips for Apple, Broadcom, Qualcomm, and numerous other tech and automotive companies. The company operates enormous, highly automated semiconductor fabrication plants. These factories use industrial machinery that relies on electric motors with powerful permanent magnets made from rare-earth elements such as neodymium, dysprosium, and terbium.

articles.title: Wenn Erdkruste und Erdmantel über den Erdkern gleiten: Warum die geografischen Pole um 10 Zentimeter pro Jahr wandern
articles.summary:
Zehn Zentimeter pro Jahr: Warum die geografischen Pole der Erde wandern
Die geografischen Pole der Erde verschieben sich derzeit mit einer per Satellit gemessenen Geschwindigkeit von rund zehn Zentimetern pro Jahr, was die durchschnittliche Driftgeschwindigkeit tektonischer Platten übersteigt. Wie in einer im Wissenschaftsmagazin Science veröffentlichten Studie zu lesen ist, handelt es sich bei solchen Geschwindigkeiten nicht bloß um kurzlebige Ausreißer der Gegenwart, da vergleichbare Verschiebungen in den vergangenen 320 Millionen Jahren mehrfach über Zeiträume von jeweils zehn Millionen Jahren auftraten.
Ein Forschungsteam um den Geowissenschaftler Mathew Domeier, den Geologen Leandro C. Gallo, die Geowissenschaftlerin Chloé M. Marcilly und den Geophysiker Trond H. Torsvik von der norwegischen Universität Oslo wies insgesamt vier solcher Phasen anhand urzeitlicher Meeresspiegelschwankungen nach. Diese Episoden lagen in den Zeitfenstern vor 200 bis 190 Millionen, vor 150 bis 140 Millionen, vor 100 bis 90 Millionen sowie vor 30 bis 20 Millionen Jahren und erreichten Raten von mindestens 0,6 Breitengraden pro einer Million Jahre, was mindestens 6,7 Zentimetern pro Jahr entspricht.

L’application, déclinée sur iOS, Android et le web, inverse le rapport habituel au chatbot, puisque l’agent surveille les comptes connectés et signale de sa propre initiative ce qui mérite votre attention. Le reste de la journée, l’agent repasse sur ces comptes toutes les quelques heures et n’écrit que lorsqu’un sujet réclame une décision. Anthropic destine l’outil « aux professionnels et aux patrons de petites entreprises qui ont plus sur les bras qu’ils ne peuvent en suivre ».
Les tâches confiées vont de la prise de rendez-vous à la construction de tableaux de bord, de prévisions financières ou de petites applications web. Propulsé par le modèle Opus 5.5, l’agent hérite de la mémoire, des compétences et des connexions déjà configurées dans le compte Claude, et se pilote à la voix comme à l’écrit.

TravClan raises $5M from Flipkart, others
TravClan said it will use the funds to expand its global supply network, enhance its technology and AI capabilities, and strengthen destination operations across key international markets.
TravClan, a traveltech startup, has raised $5 million in funding from Flipkart and August One, along with debt financing from Trifecta Capital.

Tor funciona enrutando el tráfico de un usuario a través de varios repetidores voluntarios antes de llegar a su destino final en internet. El nodo de salida es el último de esos repetidores: el único punto del recorrido que puede ver el tráfico sin cifrar antes de que salga hacia la red abierta.
El investigador, que publica bajo el seudónimo kaba, contó en su sitio personal que su conexión por SSH, el protocolo que permite iniciar sesión a distancia en un servidor, fue redirigida la mañana del viernes 2 de octubre hacia un servidor que no era el suyo.
Su programa le mostró la advertencia estándar de OpenSSH que alerta cuando la identidad de un servidor remoto cambió de forma inesperada, una señal habitual de que alguien intenta interponerse en la comunicación.
Al repetir el análisis sobre el resto de la red, kaba halló que 333 nodos de salida, alrededor de una décima parte del total, redirigían el tráfico SSH hacia los mismos 12 servidores de intercepción controlados por los atacantes.

Passage à l’heure d’hiver le 25 octobre 2026 : on dort plus ou moins ?
Comme à chaque changement d’heure, toute la question est de savoir dans quel sens s’effectue la bascule. Le site officiel de l’administration, Service public, donne la réponse : « Il faudra penser à reculer vos montres d’une heure dans la nuit du samedi 24 au dimanche 25 octobre 2026. » À 3 heures du matin, il sera donc 2 heures : la nuit de samedi à dimanche durera une heure de plus !
Faut-il pour autant se relever en pleine nuit pour régler toutes ses horloges ? Pas pour les smartphones, ordinateurs et tablettes : ils se mettent généralement à l’heure tout seuls, à condition que le réglage automatique de la date et de l’heure soit activé. En revanche, les montres classiques, les réveils, les horloges murales, les fours, les micro-ondes et les tableaux de bord des voitures non connectées devront encore être réglés à la main dimanche matin.
Ce changement d’heure peut donner l’impression qu’il intervient particulièrement tôt, et ce n’est pas totalement faux. Effectivement, l’an dernier nous sommes passés à l’heure d’hiver dans la nuit du 25 au 26 octobre.

Segundo a empresa, o catálogo também pode incluir obras narradas por sua tecnologia de voz virtual.
A Amazon começou a adotar o nome Kindle+ em páginas brasileiras, mas ainda não inclui os audiolivros no serviço. O conteúdo foi integrado apenas nos EUA e, no Brasil, segue disponível somente pela Audible.
No mercado nacional, a assinatura custa R$ 24,90 por mês. O valor foi definido em 2025, quando a Amazon elevou o preço e justificou o reajuste pela expansão do catálogo. O antigo Kindle Unlimited foi anunciado pela empresa em 2014.
A mudança de marca acontece poucas semanas depois de a Amazon apresentar uma nova geração de leitores Kindle. Os aparelhos ganharam design renovado e chegaram ao mercado brasileiro com preços a partir de R$ 899.

articles.title: Weltraumteleskop Euclid entdeckt ganz nebenbei einen unbekannten Kometen

Euclids eigentliche Aufgabe ist ambitioniert: Das Weltraumteleskop der Europäischen Raumfahrtbehörde ESA soll eine dreidimensionale Karte des Universums erstellen. Die Daten sollen auch dabei helfen, Dunkle Materie und Dunkle Energie besser zu verstehen.
Seit dem Missionsstart des Teleskops im Juli 2023 hat Euclid bereits beeindruckende Aufnahmen geliefert. Erst im Juni 2026 veröffentlichte die ESA etwa eine Aufnahme des Zentrums der Milchstraße, auf der mehr als 60 Millionen Sterne zu sehen sind.
Die Entdeckung eines Kometen durch das Weltraumteleskop kommt dagegen unerwartet. Zu verdanken ist der Zufallsfund einer Software, die gezielt nach beweglichen Objekten in astronomischen Aufnahmen sucht.
Euclid beobachtet eigentlich Galaxien – so gelang jetzt der Kometenfund
Für die Kartierung von Galaxien nimmt Euclid große Himmelsbereiche auf und nutzt dafür die sogenannte „Step-and-stare“-Methode. Dabei wird der „Blick“ des Teleskops für einige Zeit auf einen Himmelsausschnitt gerichtet, um eine längere Belichtung zu ermöglichen. Dann ist der nächste Ausschnitt dran. Jeder Bereich wird dabei in der Regel nur einmal erfasst.

articles.title: Panne Orange : comment réclamer un remboursement ?

L’opérateur a déjà annoncé un geste commercial, le doublement de l’enveloppe de données pendant un mois. Les abonnés peuvent-ils espérer mieux ? À la lecture des conditions générales d’abonnement, il est possible de demander une compensation. Le résultat n’est pas garanti, et le montant sera modeste, mais la démarche vaut d’être tentée.
Ce que prévoit le contrat
Chez Orange, l’article 11.2.2 des conditions générales d’abonnement est clair : en cas d’interruption du service mobile, le client « peut demander le remboursement de son abonnement au Service au prorata temporis de sa période d’interruption totale ». Deux conditions s’appliquent : avoir signalé l’incident à Orange, et « justifier par tout moyen » que l’on se trouvait dans la zone touchée au moment de la panne. Le remboursement prend la forme d’une remise sur l’une des factures suivantes. Le contrat prévoit toutefois quelques réserves : il parle d’interruption « totale », et exclut le remboursement si l’opérateur a mis en place « une solution alternative temporaire ».

Bengaluru-based digital trust company eMudhra has decided to exit its global SSL/TLS certificate business following a security incident involving weak cryptographic keys that prompted action from Google and Mozilla. In a regulatory filing on Thursday, the company said its board had decided to voluntarily withdraw from the business, citing rising compliance costs, increasing data sovereignty requirements and diminishing commercial returns. The decision follows the discovery of eight intermediate certificate authority keys linked to eMudhra that were found to be dangerously weak, potentially allowing attackers to impersonate legitimate websites. The keys were generated in April 2025, but the weakness remained undetected for about 18 months. Google and Mozilla subsequently moved to block the affected certificates to protect users. eMudhra Chairman V Srinivasan said the company had revoked the affected certificate authorities within 14 hours of discovering the incident and promptly disclosed the issue.

Action State Group Inc. is launching a set of open-source tools designed to let businesses independently check records of what artificial intelligence agents did, addressing a trust problem as automated systems begin buying, selling and delegating work across corporate boundaries.
The offering combines EvidenceBook, which preserves tamper-evident records, Terms Packs for evaluating agent behavior and Countersign, an independent verification service. The approach targets transactions in which a company cannot rely solely on another party’s account of an agent’s actions.
The fundamental difference between the start-up’s approach and that of observability vendors “is that most of the observability and tracing has to do with what was happening within your own walls,” said Steven Mih, Action State’s founder and chief executive. Mih was previously founder of Ahana Cloud Inc., the developer of a managed version of the Presto open-source distributed query engine. IBM Corp. acquired Ahana in 2023.
EvidenceBook gives participants their own signed transaction histories. A buyer can record what it requested and paid, while a provider records what it accepted and reported delivering. 1Password for Agents lets personal AI agents log in without ever seeing the password
Identity security company 1Password today launched 1Password for Agents, its new sign-in platform for personal artificial intelligence agents.
Agents from Meta Platforms Inc., Anthropic PBC, OpenAI Group PBC and Elon Musk’s SpaceXSI will be able to log in to people’s accounts through it without ever seeing the password.
1Password for Agents is aimed at a habit that took hold once agents started paying bills and planning vacations for people. Most of those jobs mean getting into an account. The easy route has been to paste the password into the agent’s chat window, which leaves a copy saved somewhere outside the owner’s control.
Aashish Tripathi, chief product officer at 1Password, said agents are “starting to do real work on our behalf.” In his view, an agent asked to do one task has no reason to walk away with permanent access to the whole account.
Under the new setup, the password never travels to the agent at all. A unique digital key identifies the agent to 1Password when it hits a login page, and the request that follows tells the person which account is wanted and for what. Nothing goes ahead until the person approves it on their own device, at which point 1Password types the password into the page itself.

Ai2 releases OlmoEarth v1.3 state-of-the-art AI-ready satellite embeddings for the whole planet
Ai2, the Allen Institute for Artificial Intelligence, today released a satellite map embedding model called OlmoEarth v1.3 and precomputed annual embeddings for the whole planet at various resolutions with a browser-based map-making tool.
The model compresses a year of satellite observations into a numerical fingerprint for each 10-by-10-meter patch of ground at the smallest resolution, with 64-square-meter and 128-meter also available. That fingerprint captures patterns that other software can use to distinguish crops, forests, mines and other types of land cover.
Until now, the primary way to use OlmoEarth was to fine-tune in OlmoEarth Studio, train a model for each task and run it over satellite data to make a map. That requires access to vast graphics processing unit resources and the ability to download and store imagery.
With today’s launch, users can use OlmoEarth Embeddings Explorer, a browser-based map-making tool. That means anyone can turn OlmoEarth into real work, from tracking change over time to finding similar places – no sign-in required.
An embedding represents what a model learned from millions of satellite images. OlmoEarth reads a year of radar images from data, including Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2 and Landsat. La investigación, titulada “Watching the Watchers”, analizó 12 televisores de diez fabricantes que cubren ocho sistemas operativos distintos: Amazon, Hisense, LG, Roku, Samsung, Sony, Supersonic, TCL, Vizio y Westinghouse. En conjunto representan cerca del 95% del mercado estadounidense.
Los autores corrieron 5.943 experimentos controlados con guiones automáticos que manejaban cada televisor por Wi-Fi, mientras un software de monitoreo de red capturaba todo el tráfico entrante y saliente de los equipos.
La tecnología evaluada se llama reconocimiento automático de contenido (ACR, por su sigla en inglés). Toma capturas periódicas de audio o video de lo que se ve en pantalla, las compara con una base de datos de contenidos y así identifica qué está mirando cada usuario, información que luego sirve para medir audiencias y vender publicidad dirigida.
El opt-out de Samsung y Vizio no corta el envío de datos
En los televisores con Tizen, el sistema operativo de Samsung, el tráfico asociado al ACR continuó en los 30 de 30 ensayos de su servicio de streaming propio después de que los usuarios desactivaron el rastreo. También, persistió en 41 de 60 pruebas con antena y en 18 de 30 con conexión HDMI.

Aunque muchos expertos consideran que es la teoría que más problemas cosmológicos resuelve de golpe, otros creen que hay demasiadas piezas que no cuadran. Para saber qué pasó exactamente, lo mejor sería viajar a los albores del Universo y estudiar lo que ocurrió. Pero claro, no es sencillo. Generalmente, los cálculos que se han hecho al respecto tienen un porcentaje de incertidumbre que invita mucho a la cautela.
Por eso, que unos científicos hayan logrado determinar lo que pasó en los primeros 5 minutos del Universo con solo un 0,5% de incertidumbre es todo un hito. Aunque, de nuevo, otro hito que hay que tomar con cautela. Así es la astronomía.
Tres chivatos del nacimiento del Universo. Hay tres fenómenos que los científicos han tenido en cuenta para estudiar cómo fueron los primeros momentos del Universo: la radiación de fondo de microondas, la expansión del Universo y el helio primordial. Los dos primeros se han estudiado bastante. Sin embargo, el tercero, aunque se ha calculado, no ha recibido tanta atención por parte de los astrónomos. Además, quienes sí lo habían medido habían obtenido cálculos con demasiada incertidumbre. Ahora, un equipo de investigadores de la Universidad de Minnesota ha encontrado una forma mucho más precisa de calcularlo.

articles.title: 1Password rend ses clés d'accès parées pour les attaques post-quantiques
articles.summary:
À partir de sa version 8.12.44, 1Password prend en charge les passkeys fondées sur ML-DSA, un algorithme de signature conçu pour résister aux ordinateurs quantiques. L’éditeur veut ainsi inciter les sites web à adopter ce format.
Les passkeys, ou clés d’accès, évitent qu’un site stocke un secret partagé, comme un mot de passe, afin qu’ils ne tombent pas entre les mains de pirates lors d’une fuite de données. La cryptographie qui les protège pourrait toutefois être cassée un jour par un ordinateur quantique.
ML-DSA : 1Password ajoute une signature résistante au quantique à ses passkeys
Nous rapportions en mai 2023 que 1Password allait permettre de sauvegarder, gérer et synchroniser les passkeys entre plusieurs écosystèmes. Trois ans plus tard, l'éditeur s'intéresse à leur durée de vie. Un passkey reste souvent utilisé pendant des années, et l'entreprise préfère donc proposer tôt une version résistante au quantique. Celui-ci repose sur ML-DSA, un algorithme de signature numérique standardisé par le NIST en 2024. C’est cette signature qui permet à votre appareil de prouver son identité au site.
Mais les choses vont plus vite que prévu. Et depuis 2023, l’estimation de la puissance nécessaire pour casser ces signatures a changé. À l’époque, il fallait environ 13 millions de qubits physiques (les composants matériels d’un ordinateur quantique) pour venir à bout d’une signature à courbe elliptique, et les gouvernements exigeaient une migration vers des algorithmes post-quantiques d’…

La caída coincide con la entrada en vigor, en enero de este año, de la opción de “anuncios menos personalizados” que la Comisión Europea exigió a Meta tras encontrarla en infracción de la Ley de Mercados Digitales, la norma que regula a las grandes plataformas tecnológicas en el bloque.

articles.title: Los fallos críticos de PHP acaban de hacerse públicos. Lo misterioso es que alguien ya intentaba explotarlos cuatro días antes
articles.summary:
Hay vulnerabilidades que pueden permanecer ocultas durante años y, cuando finalmente alguien las encuentra, todavía no se hacen públicas de inmediato. Comienza entonces una carrera discreta: entender qué permiten hacer, preparar una corrección y coordinar su divulgación antes de que la información llegue a quien pueda aprovecharla. Es un equilibrio delicado y bastante habitual en ciberseguridad. Lo que resulta mucho menos habitual es descubrir después que alguien ya estaba probando suerte cuando, en teoría, casi nadie fuera de ese círculo debía saber lo suficiente.
Eso es precisamente lo que Amazon Threat Intelligence asegura haber observado con PHP2Shell. Su red MadPot registró el 17 de octubre un intento de aprovechar estas vulnerabilidades, cuatro días antes de la divulgación pública coordinada y de la publicación de los parches el día 21. Amazon considera que las características de aquella actividad apuntan a un actor malicioso, pero hay una pieza que sigue sin encajar: no sabe cómo obtuvo información sobre el exploit antes de que fuera pública.
MadPot no es un servidor de producción comprometido, sino una red de honeypots, sistemas señuelo que Amazon expone para atraer actividad maliciosa y observar cómo se comportan quienes intentan atacarlos. El intento procedía además de una IP asociada a una red comercial de anonimización, uno de los indicios por los que la compañía considera probable que detrás hubiera un actor malicioso. El informe, elaborado a partir de datos oficiales de empleo, encontró que la cantidad total de jóvenes que trabajan en esas dos industrias pasó de unos 208.000 a 163.000 en tres años, una pérdida de 45.000 puestos en los rubros mejor pagos del país.
La caída no fue pareja entre los dos sectores. El empleo juvenil en el rubro de información y comunicación, que incluye a la mayoría de los trabajos tecnológicos, se redujo 30% desde fines de 2022. En finanzas, la caída fue del 10% en el mismo período.
Mientras tanto, el empleo general de ese mismo grupo etario en el resto de la economía británica se mantuvo prácticamente estable, un contraste que, según BCG, confirma que el fenómeno está concentrado en las industrias de mayor productividad y mejores salarios.
Un problema que excede a la inteligencia artificial
Raoul Ruparel, director sénior del Centro para el Crecimiento de BCG, dijo que las empresas se volvieron menos propensas a contratar personal sin experiencia, pero aclaró que la reducción del empleo juvenil “no puede explicarse solo” por la adopción de inteligencia artificial.

articles.title: New QPACK Flaws Can Crash HTTP/3 Servers, Trigger Up to 4,000-Fold Memory Amplification
articles.summary:
A remote attacker who has not logged in can crash many HTTP/3 web servers with a single connection, security firm FoxIO disclosed, releasing working proof-of-concept code.
By sending a small batch of compressed HTTP headers that expands in memory to a much larger set, the attacker can force the server to use thousands of times more memory than it received, enough to run a default server out of memory.
The flaws cause only denial-of-service attacks, with no evidence of data theft or code execution and no public reports of attacks in the wild. Fixes are out for quic-go, Cloudflare quiche, lsquic and Wireshark, but Bun, the h3 Rust library and aioquic were still unpatched at disclosure.
FoxIO found the same class of flaw in seven of ten HTTP/3 stacks it tested. The common cause is in QPACK, the scheme HTTP/3 uses to compress request headers so repeated fields travel as a short code instead of the full text.
A server is supposed to cap the size of the headers after it unpacks them. The affected stacks cap the compressed batch that arrives on the wire, but not the unpacked result, or they apply the cap too late, so a single request can expand into hundreds of thousands of header entries that the server holds in memory.
The reach is wide because these stacks sit under common software. quic-go is the Go library behind Caddy, Traefik and cloudflared; lsquic is LiteSpeed's library, used in LiteSpeed Web Server and OpenLiteSpeed; and Bun's HTTP/3 server runs on lsquic.
